Note
Nobody has walked these steps in LN yet. Follow them as written, and expect a screen or a label to differ. Walk it to say, at each step, whether it matched.

Walk itone step at a time · 5 steps

Before you start

  • You need step 1.2 (Confirm the test design); step 2.3 (Create two item groups); step 2.6 (Create two item groups).

Steps

Screen
Master Data➔Items➔Defaults➔Item Control and Defaults by Site tcibd1552m000

Why LN works this way. The Create controls can be governed at the site instead of the company. When Centrally Managed is selected the site mirrors the company defaults and the controls are disabled here; when it is cleared the site's own controls decide, and an item created before this is checked can arrive with fewer subentities than its group promised, with no message naming the cause.

Warning
This task has not been walked for the new groups. Note the Centrally Managed state and the saved Create controls as you go.
StepActionYou should see
5.1Open the row for the site, Product and the purchased group. The site is from step 1.2 (Confirm the test design), and the group from step 2.3 (Create two item groups)The purchased site-control row opens
5.2Read Centrally ManagedThe source of the Create controls is visible
5.3If centrally managed, check the subentities are disabled locally. Ordering, Purchase and Warehousing mirror Configure the purchased group
5.4If not, select them and saveThe purchased site is marked to create those subentities
5.5Repeat steps 5.1–5.4 for the made group. Use Ordering, Production, Warehousing and Sales; the made group is the one from step 2.6 (Create two item groups)The made site is marked to create those subentities
